title: Abklingphase einer Entzündung
artist: 3sat/nano/DOCUVISTA Filmproduktion/Marilena Schulte,Maike Wurtscheid/Jörg Becker,Sergios Roth/Tatjana Theuer/Jochen Schm
description: In the decay phase, inflammation-dissolving messenger substances are released. Type M2 macrophages dispose of debris from cells and tissues. At the same time, other immune cells begin the first repair measures.

title: Altarabische Gottheiten
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Sahar Eslah, Martin Carazo Mendez/ Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Igor
description: Many gods were worshiped in ancient Arabia until the advent of Islam. There was a high god and local gods who were worshiped. Many were probably descendants of millennia-old deities who were already worshiped in the Middle East.

title: Anatomie des Herzens
artist: 3sat/nano/Bluemoon Media/Volker Wasmut,Patrick Zeilhofer/Tobias Adams/Jochen Schmidt
description: The human heart weighs around 350 grams, beats around 70 times per minute and is mostly made up of muscle tissue. The heart septum runs between the two halves of the heart.

title: Autarke Ernährung in Deutschland
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Autorenkombinat/Birthe Heer/Tobias Lenz/Dennis Heislitz/Maximilian Mohr
description: Can Germany feed itself without food imports? The good news: we produce grain, potatoes, meat, milk and cheese 100 percent and more in-house. For vegetarians, however, it could be tight.

title: Bahnbrechende Entdeckungen der Antike
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Cristina Trebbi/ Jens Boeck, Dieter Stürmer / Fabian Wienke / Sebastian Martinez/ xk
description: The ancient Greeks laid the foundations for the development of science and pioneered inventions.

title: Das KZ Auschwitz-Birkenau
artist: ZDF/ Terra X/ Winfried Laasch, Friedrich Scherer/Kawom!
description: From the end of 1941 a new camp was built in the so-called “Auschwitz Area of Interest” of the SS. It was three kilometers away from the existing Auschwitz concentration camp. From March 1942, people were murdered by poison gas in two former farmhouses in Birkenau.

title: Das Magnetfeld der Erde
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Bilderfest/Tillman Graach/Moritz Krause/Benjamin Calliari-Herzberg/Maximilian Heß
description: The Earth's magnetic field can be imagined as if there were a huge bar magnet inside the Earth. Because it has two poles, it is called a dipole. So-called field lines form around such a magnet.

file: File:Das Straßennetz im antiken Rom (CC BY 4.0).webm
title: Das Straßennetz im antiken Rom
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Cristina Trebbi/ Jens Boeck, Dieter Stürmer / Fabian Wienke / Sebastian Martinez/ xk
description: The Roman Empire benefited from an extensive road network. Transport routes emerged throughout the empire. Above all, the many legionaries from the individual provinces had to serve as construction workers.

title: Demokratie in Athen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Cristina Trebbi/ Jens Boeck, Dieter Stürmer / Fabian Wienke / Sebastian Martinez/ xk
description: The first forms of democracy emerged in Athens in antiquity. "Rule of the people" - was the key formula. But the opinion of children, women, slaves and foreigners was not asked.

title: Der Deutsche Wetterdienst
artist: 3sat/nano/Werwiewas Medienproduktion/Uta Meyer/Marika Bent/Robert Cöllen/Martin Langner/Katja Jopp
description: The state German weather service in Offenbach is the largest data collector and processor in this country. With almost 2,400 employees, it is one of the most important national weather services worldwide.

title: Der Humboldtstrom
artist: ZDF/Terra X/R.Marel/S.Hillmann/C.Gerisch/A.Kindler/SpiegelTV/Maximilian Mohr
description: This ocean current transports cold, nutrient-rich deep water from Antarctica north along the west coast of South America. Every second it moves 15 million cubic meters of water, about 75 million bath tub fillings.

title: Der Löwe - ein Symboltier
artist: ZDF/Tango Film, Pelorus Jack Filmprods LLC/Eva-Maria Gfirtner, Judith Adlhoch/Markus Strobel, Tim Henkel/Jan-Philipp Sta
description: Since time immemorial, the lion has been revered for its strength. Already in the Stone Age - more than thirty thousand years ago - the big cats were immortalized in works of art.

title: Der Menstruationszyklus
artist: ZDF/TerraX/Anke Plascher/Ellen Haas/Anna-Lena Neidlinger/MUSIK Maximilian Mohr
description: From the first menstruation until menopause, a hormonal cycle regulates the female body to prepare it for a possible pregnancy. The cycle can be divided into different phases.

title: Der Planet Mars
artist: ZDF/nano/Raketenfilm/Andreas Gust/Konstantin Fuchs
description: Mars is so attractive to us humans because it is our closest neighbor planet. It formed just a little earlier than the earth and can tell us a lot about its development and that of the solar system.

title: Der Sturm auf die Bastille
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Ricarda Schlosshan/Alisa Ruprecht/South und Browse/Maximilian Heß
description: The storming of the Bastille on July 14, 1789 is considered the symbolic beginning of the French Revolution. The Paris fortress was the symbol of the king's arbitrary rule. But the storming cost many people their lives.

file: File:Der Umgang mit dem Tod in den Religionen.webm
title: Der Umgang mit dem Tod in den Religionen
artist: ZDF/Sonntags/Peter Schmidt/Marietta Pauli
description: How do Jews, Christians, Muslims, Hindus and Buddhists deal with death and the dead? Each religion has its own tradition.

title: Der natürliche Wasserkreislauf
artist: 3sat/nano, Spiegel TV, Christine Voges, R. Engelke+S. Karim+F. Gutsche+J. Heck+B. Asgari, K. Scheef+F. Buscha, Tim Kunte
description: The natural water cycle is driven by the sun: Its heat radiation allows water from oceans, lakes and rivers to evaporate into water vapor. As precipitation, the water reaches lakes, rivers and groundwater and ultimately flows into the sea.

title: Der nördliche Polarkreis
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Spiegel TV Media/R.Hillmann/R.Marel/C.Gerisch/A.Kindler/Maximilian Mohr
description: Like a magical border, the Arctic Circle stretches around the world along the 66th degree of latitude and touches very different countries and regions. The vast region within the Arctic Circle is also a veritable treasure trove of raw materials.

title: Die Anasazi - Hochkultur im Chaco
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Tobias Schultes/Oliver Roetz, Maria Zimmermann/Marc Trompetter
description: In the 11th and 12th centuries, a once great culture settled in the south of the USA - in the Chaco Canyon: the Anasazi. How was that possible in an area where it did not rain for almost ten months a year?

title: Die Anden als Klimascheide
artist: ZDF/Terra X/R.Marel/S.Hillmann/C.Gerisch/A.Kindler/SpiegelTV/Maximilian Mohr
description: Patagonia is located at the southernmost tip of the American continent. The Andes divide the country into a Chilean and an Argentine part. The Patagonian Andes are an extreme climate divide.

title: Die Ausbreitung der Ur-Germanen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Sabine Bier, Sahar Eslah, Cristina Trebbi/Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Claudia Spo
description: The ancestors of the Germanic peoples probably lived in Eurasia. Around 1000 BC A part of them reached the settlement area between the Baltic Sea and the Alps and spread over the centuries to the Danube, the Vistula and Scandinavia.

title: Die Bedeutung von Pfingsten
artist: ZDF/Sonntags/Brigitte Duczek/Marietta Pauli
description: Pentecost is celebrated by Christians around the world. In some languages there is what it is about. In Greek it is called Penticosti (50). Because 50 days after the resurrection of Jesus something happened. The festival goes back to Jewish traditions.

title: Die Entstehung der Alpen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Bilderfest/Florian Breier, Christian Stiefenhofer/Michi Kern/Klaus Wache/Tobias Forth/Maik Siegle/Peter Rieg
description: The Alps are Central Europe's highest mountains. They rise up to 4800 meters. Today it is mainly the rough weather that shapes the Alps. But the forces that unfolded these mountains came from within the earth.

title: Die Entstehung des Grundgesetzes
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Ellen Haas/Anna-Lena Neidlinger/Maximilian Heß/Bundesarchiv: Welt im Film Nr.172/1948: B-86630 und Nr. 207/1
description: It took eight months to draft. The aim was to create a legal basis for a peaceful and just life for all.

title: Die Entstehung des Lebens
artist: ZDF/TerraX/R. Schlosshan/F. Haedecke/C. Ruby/F. Wienke/Gruppe 5/Jochen Schmidt
description: Amino acids, sugar, bases and fats are needed for life to develop at all. Add RNA, an acid and a kind of chemical Morse code - this is how chains with building blocks are created. But only a protective fat cover makes the chains into a cell.

title: Die Erfindung der Batterie
artist: ZDF/scobel/Claus Ast/Tamara Skalski/Maximilian Mohr
description: By layering copper discs, cardboard dipped in acid and zinc discs, physicist Alessandro Volta invented the so-called "Volta Column," the world's first battery.

file: File:Die Ermordung der Juden im Nationalsozialismus.webm
title: Die Ermordung der Juden im Nationalsozialismus
artist: ZDF/Terra X/L. Schöler/J. Geiß/K. J. Sturm/K. Waldmann/M. Fandel/B. Leng/Margot Friedländer Zeitzeugin/Matthias Hass, Ay
description: At the Wannsee Conference, Reinhard Heydrich explains the strategy: the National Socialists no longer want to expel the Jews, they want to murder them. To this end, extermination camps are set up in the east of the area controlled by Germans.

file: File:Die Flucht der Juden vor den Nationalsozialisten.webm
title: Die Flucht der Juden vor den Nationalsozialisten
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Leonie Schöler/Julia Geiß/Michael Fandel/Benjamin Leng/Margot Friedländer Zeitzeugin
description: Many Jews hope for an end to the reign of terror – others flee. By 1941 around 350,000 Jews had left Germany. But emigrating is difficult because many states restrict the acceptance of Jewish refugees.

title: Die Fotosynthese der Bäume
artist: ZDF/pur/Brigitte Böttcher/Autorenkombinat: Tobi Schönke, Daniel Beißmann/Jochen Schmidt
description: With photosynthesis, trees control one of the most important biological processes in the world. With the help of their leaves and the dye chlorophyll, they produce their own food with just three ingredients and still produce fresh oxygen.

title: Die Gaskammern in Auschwitz-Birkenau
artist: ZDF/ Terra X/ Winfried Laasch/ Friedrich Scherer/Kawom!
description: In March 1943, the first of four large murder facilities went into operation in Auschwitz-Birkenau. The processes in the newly built gas chambers were well thought out down to the last detail.

file: File:Die Germanen aus der Sicht von Tacitus und Caesar.webm
title: Die Germanen aus der Sicht von Tacitus und Caesar
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Sabine Bier, Sahar Eslah, Cristina Trebbi/Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Claudia Spo
description: The Roman historian Tacitus claimed to know what makes the Teutons tick. They are stubborn - sometimes in a bad way. For Caesar they were the purest chaos and thus the absolute contrast to his Roman soldiers.

title: Die Geschichte des Hanfs
artist: ZDF/Terra X/J. v. Kalkreuth/D. da Cruz/Maximilian Mohr
description: The history of hemp began with cannabis as a medicine. 2700 BC it was first documented. Long controversial and banned, countries around the world are now relaxing their restrictive cannabis laws.

title: Die Geschichte des Impfens
artist: 3sat/nano/Raketenfilm/Andreas Gust/Konstantin Fuchs
description: Since when have vaccinations been available, how do they work and what are their side effects?

title: Die Geschichte des Kolonialismus
artist: ZDF/Pur+/gomie production GmbH/Nadja Stein/Richard Bade/Manos Dosis/Maximilian
description: The history of European colonialism began about 500 years ago. At that time, powerful people from Europe sent seafarers all over the world to occupy large areas. They called these areas "colonies".

title: Die Gotteshäuser der Religionen
artist: ZDF/Sonntags/Harald Hamm/Marietta Pauli/Jochen Schmidt
description: With Judaism, Christianity, Islam and Hinduism there are four world religions, and each religion has its own place of worship. But what do the terms synagogue, church, mosque and temple actually mean?

file: File:Die Gründung Bagdads im 8. Jahrhundert (CC BY-SA 4.0).webm
title: Die Gründung Bagdads im 8. Jahrhundert
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/Faber Courtial, Susanne Utzt, Sahar Eslah, Martin Carazo Mendez/ Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachi
description: Baghdad, in what is now Iraq, was built in the eighth century on an important trade route between the Euphrates and Tigris rivers. The metropolis was probably planned as a "round city".

title: Die Götterwelt der Griechen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Cristina Trebbi/ Jens Boeck, Dieter Stürmer / Fabian Wienke / Sebastian Martinez/ xk
description: From the mighty god Zeus to the all-rounder Apollon. The Greek world of gods is dazzling.

title: Die Herrschaftsstruktur im arabischen Reich
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Sahar Eslah, Martin Carazo Mendez/ Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Igor
description: Around 700 AD the Arabs ruled over about 60 million people. At the head of the empire was a caliph. Immediately below that came the governors of the provinces, who mainly collected taxes.

title: Die Himmelsscheibe von Nebra
artist: ZDF/Terra X/SPIEGEL TV/Christopher Gerisch/Tilman Remme/Reiner Bauer, Oliver Gurr/Oliver Roetz, Philipp Klein/Hauke Kete
description: The Nebra sky disk is the world's oldest known concrete representation of astronomical phenomena and is more than 3600 years old. It shows a crescent moon, the full moon - sometimes interpreted as the sun - and a total of 32 stars.

title: Die Katastrophe von Fukushima
artist: ZDF/TerraX/Zeitsprung Pictures/Carl-Ludwig Paeschke/Studio Paeper/Michael Mueller
description: On March 11, 2011, a seaquake shook the sea floor in the Pacific. The following waves flood the site of the nuclear power plant. The power supply breaks down. There is a meltdown.

title: Die Lebensräume der Löwen
artist: ZDF/Tango Film, Pelorus Jack Filmprods LLC/Eva-Maria Gfirtner, Judith Adlhoch/Markus Strobel, Tim Henkel/Jan-Philipp Sta
description: In the 1960s there were still more than enough good areas in Africa. Almost the entire continent was inhabited by lions. The big cats have now lost more than three quarters of their original range.

title: Die Rüsselnasen der Saiga-Antilopen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Viking Film/Iris Gesang/Andreas Kieling, Frank Gutsche/Christian R.Timmann/Richard Sako, Boris Bürgel, Marku
description: Saiga antelopes are amazingly persistent. On their long hikes through the steppes of Kazakhstan, the Saigas can cover 80 kilometers and more in one day. Their enormous trunk helps them with this. But the nose can do even more.

title: Die Schichten der Erdatmosphäre
artist: ZDF/TerraX/Julia Knüppel/Ellen Haas/Malik Alpoguz/Maximilian Mohr
description: The air envelope of the earth is called the atmosphere. It varies in pressure and temperature at different altitudes. Therefore, the atmosphere is divided into five main layers according to altitude.

title: Die Sinne des Wolfs
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Spiegel TV/Kirsten Hoehne, Nanje de Joung-Teuscher/Anja Schütze, Uli Weinlein, Rainer Wolf/Tricky
description: The wolf's sense organs are highly developed. Its panoramic view covers a field of view of around 240 degrees. His hearing is also excellent. But the sense of smell is most important to the hunter.

title: Die Temperamenten Lehre
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Sahar Eslah, Martin Carazo Mendez/ Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Igor
description: The theory of temperament was developed by Greek scholars in ancient times and used by Islamic doctors in the Middle Ages. It was once used to treat diseases that could not be surgically cured.

file: File:Die Temperaturkurve der Erde (ZDF, Terra X) 720p HD 50FPS.webm
title: Die Temperaturkurve der Erde
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/Luise Wagner, Jonas Sichert, Andreas Hougardy
description: Climate change, Temperature in history of Earth, Video of Terra X.

title: Die Weltkarte von Mercator
artist: ZDF/Terra X/SPIEGEL TV/Christopher Gerisch/Tilman Remme/Reiner Bauer, Oliver Gurr/Oliver Roetz/Hauke Ketelsen/Richard Sa
description: In 1569, Gerhard Mercator presented his world map to the public for the first time. The 1 meter 34 by 2 meter 12 meter card was given the title addition: "for marine use". It was later divided into 20 single sheets and published in a book. Long awaited by the captains of the world.

file: File:Die britische Corona-Mutante und ihre Auswirkungen.webm
title: Die britische Corona-Mutante und ihre Auswirkungen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/WENDEVARGA/Christine Haak, Frank Siegwart, Albrecht M. Wendlandt
description: All viruses change over time. When a virus hijacks a host cell, it allows its genetic make-up to multiply, and new variants with small changes emerge. However, the English version of Sars-Cov-2 has an unusually large number of mutations.

title: Die ersten Zahlungsmittel
artist: ZDF/ Terra X/ Gruppe5 /Sabine Klauser / Sebastian Martinez
description: Mankind's money ranged from iron sticks to cocoa beans. The most common currency of all time, however, was the cowrie snail. In the early Chinese years, it even served as the official key currency.

title: Die klimatische Funktion des Regenwaldes
artist: ZDF/TerraXPress/Christiane Mayer/Anna-Lena Neidlinger
description: The extensive, dense rainforests extract CO2 from the air particularly effectively, use the carbon for growth and release oxygen. Its destruction leads to a dramatic intensification of climate change.

title: Dinosaurierspuren in Deutschland
artist: ZDF/TerraX/Andreas Sommer/Martin Schaaf/Jochen Schmidt
description: In a Germany before our time, giant lizards roamed through lake landscapes and primeval forests. Many traces of its past can still be found today.

file: File:Drei wichtige Hormone für den Stoffwechsel Terra X.webm
title: Drei wichtige Hormone für den Stoffwechsel Terra X
artist: 3sat/nano, Telekult, Petra Cyrus, Thomas Henk Henkel+Knut Muhsik, Lena Hatebur), tricky GbR
description: Hunger and body weight are affected by these three important hormones: leptin, insulin and ghrelin. Together they significantly regulate our metabolism.

file: File:Einfluss von Fetten und Proteinen auf den Blutzuckerspiegel.webm
title: Einfluss von Fetten und Proteinen auf den Blutzuckerspiegel
artist: ZDF/3sat/nano/DOCUVISTA/Thomas Hies/Andrea Schäfer, Marilena Schulte/Jörg Becker/Henry Müller/Jochen Schmidt
description: Fats and proteins affect blood sugar levels. In addition, they can also delay gastric emptying. The blood sugar level then rises more moderately.

file: File:Einfluss von Lebensmitteln auf unser Klima.webm
title: Einfluss von Lebensmitteln auf unser Klima
artist: ZDF/logo/Steffi Thum
description: By the time groceries end up in the shopping basket, production, transport, storage and cooling have produced a lot of climate-damaging greenhouse gases such as CO2. Therefore, food also has an impact on our climate.

title: Eingeschränkter Lebensraum der Wildtiere
artist: 3sat/nano/Axel Gomille/Michael Habermehl/Sebastian Heger/Sophie Lochau/Ute Rübesamen
description: Due to the urban sprawl, the natural habitat of animals is being cut up into ever smaller areas. The result: their freedom of movement is influenced to different degrees.

title: Einzigartige Lebensbedingungen auf der Erde
artist: ZDF/Terra X/ Story House Productions/ Sigrun Laste/ Jürgen Rehberg, André Götzmann/ Ronald Rist/ Rudi Kirschen, Tom Zwic
description: 14 billion years ago, the Big Bang gradually created suns, planets, galaxies and stars. Unique: the earth. Water, heat, and the protective shield of the atmosphere create conditions that are likely to occur only once in the entire universe

title: Entnazifizierung nach dem Krieg
artist: ZDF/TerraX/Leonie Schöler/Julia Geiß/Michael Fandel/Benjamin Leng/Margot Friedländer, Zeitzeugin/Mirko Drotschmann
description: Germany is divided into four occupation zones. The USA, France and Great Britain administer the West, the Soviet Union takes over the East. How successful is the denazification by the victors?

file: File:Entstehung der Alpen CC BY 4.0 Terra X plus.webm
title: Entstehung der Alpen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Bilderfest/Florian Breier, Christian Stiefenhofer/Klaus Wache Dieses Video ist eine Produktion des ZDF, in Z
description: Die Alpen sind Europas höchstes Gebirge. Sie ragen bis auf 4800 Meter hinauf. Doch vor 150 Millionen Jahren lag dort, wo heute Europa ist, noch ein Ur-Meer: die Tethys. Erst mit dem Zusammenstoß der Kontinentalplatten wurde das Ur-Meer verschluckt. Kilometerdicke Gesteinsschichten haben sich gefalte

title: Entstehungsphase einer Entzündung
artist: 3sat/nano/DOCUVISTA Filmproduktion/Marilena Schulte,Maike Wurtscheid/Jörg Becker,Sergios Roth/Tatjana Theuer/Jochen Schm
description: If a foreign body penetrates the skin, phagocytes in the damaged tissue are the first to react. So-called macrophages of type M1 release inflammatory messenger substances. Among other things, prostaglandins. These hormones trigger a pain stimulus.

title: Erfindung des Periodensystems
artist: ZDF/Terra X/T. Schrader/J. Köster/F. Steinhardt/Caligari/moods in pictures/Maximilian Mohr
description: In the middle of the 19th century, the nature of the elements is still a largely unknown world. In 1869, the Russian chemist Dimitri Mendeleev developed the periodic table, which with slight adjustments is still valid today.

title: Esel als Bodenmanager
artist: ZDF/TerraX/Luisa Zech, Lara Franke/Tobias Lenz/Sebastian Kerz/ MUSIK NN
description: Donkeys love to roll around extensively. With this habit, the animals can protect the soil and allow plants to grow better.

title: Evolution der Hand
artist: ZDF/3sat/Marco Polo Film AG/Herbert Ostwald/Holger Hauff/Armin Riegel/Maximilian Heß
description: Around 380 million years ago, paleontologists estimate, there were fish whose pectoral fins already had finger-like bones. The extremities of vertebrates developed from this. The skeleton of these limbs is based on the same blueprint.

title: Experiment zur Relativitätstheorie
artist: ZDF/scobel/xkopp/Bianca Zarandi/Maximilian Mohr
description: Is mass bendable enough to form a kind of tunnel from one place in spacetime to another? The equations of relativity theory allow for the existence of such wormholes. This would theoretically make time travel possible.

title: Feinstaubbelastung und die Folgen
artist: 3sat/nano/Labo M/Johan von Mirbach/Chris Caliman/Christoph Valentien/Till Vielrose/Johannes Nakajima/Rada Dechev/
description: We breathe in and out about 20,000 times every day. Fine dust particles get into the nasal cavity and windpipe. Our body's cleansing systems are overwhelmed when exposed to high levels of stress. The airways swell and there is a risk of dangerous inflammation.

title: Felsen als Wasserspeicher für Pflanzen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Florian Roth/Thomas Kuschke/Jochen Rall/Maximilian Mohr
description: Plants can grow and flourish not only on earthy subsoil, but also on rocks and rocks. The rock layers below the thin upper soil layer can store water due to their porosity.

title: Folgen der Erderwärmung
artist: 3sat/nano, Spiegel TV, Christine Voges, R. Engelke+S. Karim+F. Gutsche+J. Heck+B. Asgari, K. Scheef+F. Buscha, Tim Kunte
description: Humans have also been a driving force behind climate change for around 200 years - they use fossil fuels to fuel global warming processes. The increased annual average temperatures are already leading to an increase in extreme weather worldwide.

title: Frankfurter Paulskirche
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Faber Courtial/Jörg Courtial
description: The first all-German parliament met in Frankfurt's Paulskirche on May 18, 1848 to discuss a liberal constitution and the formation of a German nation-state under the colors black-red-gold.

title: Freizeit im antiken Rom
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Story House Productions/Jens Afflerbach, Sebastian Scherrer/Jürgen Rehberg/Franziska Menz/Eike Wichmann, Fri
description: In ancient Rome there were entertainment and red light districts, thermal baths, theaters and sports facilities such as the Circus Maximus. This was by far the most popular entertainment.

title: Gedankenexperiment Schrödingers Katze
artist: ZDF/nano/Raketenfilm/Andreas Gust/Konstantin Fuchs
description: The Austrian Erwin Schrödinger was one of the pioneers of quantum physics. He is best known for an experiment he fortunately never carried out: Schrödinger's cat - a thought experiment.

title: Gefahr durch chronische Entzündungskrankheiten
artist: 3sat/nano/DOCUVISTA Filmproduktion/Marilena Schulte, Maike Wurtscheid/Jörg Becker, Sergios Roth/Tatjana Theuer/Jochen Sc
description: If the immune system remains permanently active, a smoldering fire occurs in the body, in a sense. Inflammatory foci are constantly fueled - until they become chronic. This also destroys healthy tissue.

title: Germanische Führungseliten
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Sabine Bier, Sahar Eslah, Cristina Trebbi/Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Claudia Spo
description: The Germanic ruling elite consisted only of men. They achieved their reputation primarily through bravery in battle, through rich harvests, or through belonging to a noble clan.

title: Geschichte der Hauptstadt Berlin
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/Friedrich Scherer/Jörg Adams/Mathias Meyer/Faber Courtial, Jörg Courtial
description: Berlin is the capital of the Federal Republic of Germany and is the largest German city by population. She can look back on an eventful history.

title: Geschichte der Klimakonferenz
artist: ZDF/logo/Judith Vehar
description: In 1992 politicians from almost every country in the world met for the first climate conference. Not much has happened in years, however. It wasn't until 2015 at the Paris Climate Conference that there was a real treaty: the Paris Climate Agreement.

title: Geschichte des Berliner Reichstagsgebäudes
artist: ZDF/Friedrich Scherer/Fritz Göran Vöpel
description: From 1884 the seat of the parliament was built in Berlin, making it the most important place of German democracy. After it was destroyed in World War II and rebuilt in the 1960s, the Reichstag was again given a glass dome in 1999.

title: Geschichtliche Entwicklung der Xenophobie
artist: 3sat/nano/SPIEGEL TV GmbH /Denise Dismer, John A. Kantara/Jakob Kastner/Ezra Tsegaye/Jochen Schmidt
description: Prejudices against strangers have been handed down from antiquity. The ancient Greeks called the strangers "barbarians". At first it only meant all people who did not speak Greek.

title: Gesundheitsrisiko Einsamkeit
artist: ZDF/Terra X/C. Schrader/J. Köster/moods in pictures/Maximilian Mohr
description: A study conducted before the pandemic found that “loneliness” poses a similarly high risk to health as “smoking” and is even more important than “obesity” and “lack of exercise”.

file: File:Gibt es einen Fahrstuhl in den Weltraum (CC BY 4.0).webm
title: Gibt es einen Fahrstuhl in den Weltraum
artist: ZDF/Terra X/ T. Schultes/ pro in space
description: The elevator should slide upwards like on a rail. To date, however, there is no suitable material for such a rope. So the elevator into space remains a dream.

title: Gladiatoren im antiken Rom
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Susanne Utzt, Cristina Trebbi/ Jens Boeck, Dieter Stürmer / Fabian Wienke / Sebastian Martinez/ xk
description: The gladiators were superstars in ancient Rome. They had a short but exciting life. The blood of fearless fighters was even traded as a sexual enhancer - the ancient Viagra.

title: Haarmode bei den Germanen
artist: ZDF/Terra X/Gruppe 5/ Sabine Bier, Sahar Eslah, Cristina Trebbi/Martin Christ, Marc Riemer, Joachim C. Seck/ Claudia Spo
description: The men made a fuss about their hair, which they extensively styled with their all-purpose weapon, the comb. The Sueben knot was particularly popular.

artist: ZDF/Sonntags/Katrin Müller-Walde/Marietta Pauli/Maximilian Mohr

description: Lap dogs may have been showered and pampered with luxury like never before in history. But not all Romans were in the mood for such little dogs. Hunting dogs also had their permanent place: greyhounds, bloodhounds or massive Molossians.
